prompt: In a full mesh of distinct nodes with one undirected link per pair and no self-links, a developer adds up each node’s neighbour count. What does this total measure?

options.explanation: Each link is counted at both endpoints.
This misses the second endpoint’s contribution.

options.text: The number of nodes, regardless of network size.
options.explanation: The total changes with connectivity as well as node count.
The model excludes both direction and self-links.

workedExample: Take one link between Alice’s node and Ben’s node. It appears once in Alice’s neighbour list and once in Ben’s. Every link behaves the same way, so halve the total. Adding one new node requires a new link to every existing node.
